name: components-backgrounds-hole
title: Hole Background
description: A dark canvas draws a funnel of fine concentric rings that narrows toward a bright glowing mouth at the bottom. A coloured beam shifts hue across the opening while small white specks drift upward.
use: A dark hero or section background for a sci-fi, AI or event page that wants depth without a photo.
avoid: It is a full-bleed canvas that needs a sized parent, runs a constant loop, and its purple beam fights light themes.
a11y: Decorative canvas with no reduced-motion pause; the constant ring render and drifting particles keep running off screen. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Nearly black frame filled with faint grey concentric ellipses that widen from a bright opening near the bottom centre, like looking into a funnel. A blurred vertical beam of magenta, purple and blue light rises from that mouth, and tiny white dots float inside. A subtle scanline texture lies over everything.
behaves: The coloured beam slides its gradient upward on a five-second loop so the mouth shifts from magenta through purple to blue, and the whole ring field slowly recedes. Small particles rise and respawn, giving a slow drift.
customise: Set the stroke colour, number of rings, number of discs and particle colour through props; the beam hues, loop timing and overlay gradients are fixed in the source.
weight: heavy: A requestAnimationFrame canvas redraws dozens of rings, lines and 100 particles every frame.
